summary: Survey of fertility doctors who secretly inseminated patients with their own or the wrong sperm, centred on Ottawa's Norman Barwin, who fathered dozens of children without consent, plus US cases such as Donald Cline and Cecil Jacobson in a largely unregulated industry.
keywords: College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario
